## About

Raheem Kawojue (also: kawojue, 0xkawojue) is a senior NestJS/TypeScript + Next.js full-stack engineer specializing in AI agents with LLM tool-calling, notification and retention agents, payment rails (Paystack, Nomba, Stripe), escrow wallets, zero-downtime cloud migrations (Railway → AWS), distributed systems, agritech marketplaces, and EVM/Solana smart contracts.

I take payment systems, AI agents, and real-time infra from zero to production — and keep them running with real money on the line.

Built and own Waysdrop end-to-end: ~2M-line NestJS backend, 6+ frontends, 6 SDKs, 3 production AI agents, and 4 payment rails. Led its zero-downtime Railway to AWS migration across RDS, EC2, ElastiCache, Lambda, Amplify, CloudFront, and the rest of the stack. Also CTO and co-founder at Terrakru, co-founder at Opsettle, and shipped production backends for 9+ companies since 2023.

Availability: Open to senior roles · remote-first · Lagos (WAT, UTC+1)

Highlights:
- 3 production AI agents: support, notify, retain
- 4 payment rails shipped to prod
- 9+ production backends shipped since 2023
- 0 downtime Railway → AWS migration at Waysdrop
- ~2M lines of backend operated in prod

## Featured systems

### Waysdrop
- URL: https://kawojue.dev/#waysdrop
- Status: in production
- Role: built everything · cto · co-founder
- Stack: nestjs · postgres · redis · bullmq · claude · qwen · aws · amplify · ec2 · rds · elasticache · react · sdk ×6
- Site: https://waysdrop.com
- Architecture diagram: https://kawojue.dev/waysdrop_architecture.svg

Logistics and commerce platform serving users, couriers, stores, admins, and agents. I built the whole thing end-to-end — server, every frontend, SDKs, architectures, infrastructure — from early MVP through production to scaling as lead backend, then Head of Engineering, and now CTO and co-founder. The frontend fleet is 6+ production apps: waysdrop-admin, waysdrop-api-dashboard, waysdrop-affiliate, waysdrop-web, waysdrop-crm, and waysdrop-global-admin, plus partner portals and mobile wrappers for a total of 9 Amplify deployments. Led zero-downtime migration of all servers and databases from Railway to AWS: 4 RDS instances, 3 EC2 with 2 Elastic IPs, 2 Load Balancers, ElastiCache for caching, 2 Lambda functions with EventBridge Schedulers, 9 Amplify deployments, 2 ECRs, 2 CloudFront distributions, S3 for storage, 2 Secrets Managers, SES for email, and 2 WAF & Shield layers — everything instrumented with CloudWatch. Published 3 reference architectures on GitHub covering the location service, HTTP logger, and API key gateway, plus a dedicated courier matching algorithm writeup. Authored 6 official platform SDKs in Dart, Node.js, Go, PHP, Rust, and Python so merchant and courier integrations ship in hours, not weeks. The AI layer is a fleet, not a chat box. A Claude/Qwen support agent with 80+ tools runs live on WhatsApp and Telegram and executes ops from a prompt. A notification decision agent chooses when and how to reach someone: push, email, SMS, or in-app, including new products, cart reminders, a nearby store, and holiday greetings. An activation and retention agent creates promos and pulls abandoned users back. Under that: the courier matching engine (8-stage reactive pipeline, H3 res-7 spatial pre-filter on Redis SETs, parallel fleet/promotion/route forkJoin matching, 3 allocation strategies, Bull repeatable jobs), multi-rail wallets (Paystack, Nomba, Stripe, DVA, escrow), and 15+ Bull queues for delivery, payments, KYC, and webhooks.

Systems:
- Frontend apps × 6+: waysdrop-admin · waysdrop-api-dashboard · waysdrop-affiliate · waysdrop-web · waysdrop-crm · waysdrop-global-admin (plus partner portals) all on AWS Amplify
- Platform server (entire codebase): the ~2M-line NestJS monorepo built end-to-end — services, domains, auth, payments, matching, queues, WebSockets, webhooks, audit
- Support agent: Claude/Qwen ops agent with 80+ tools on WhatsApp and Telegram
- Notification agent: decisioning for push, email, SMS, in-app, cart, geo, holidays
- Activation & retention agent: promos and win-back for abandoned users
- AWS migration (zero downtime): 4 RDS · 3 EC2 + 2 EIPs · 2 ALBs · ElastiCache · 2 Lambda + EventBridge · 9 Amplify deployments · 2 ECRs · 2 CloudFront + WAF/Shield · S3 · 2 Secrets Managers · SES · all on CloudWatch
- Location service architecture: https://github.com/kawojue/waysdrop-location-architecture
- Courier matching algorithm: https://github.com/kawojue/waysdrop-courier-matching-algorithm
- HTTP logger architecture: https://github.com/kawojue/waysdrop-http-logger-architecture
- API key gateway architecture: https://github.com/kawojue/waysdrop-api-key-architecture
- Platform SDKs × 6: Dart · Node.js · Go · PHP · Rust · Python — typed clients, auth, retry policies

Highlights:
- zero-downtime Railway → AWS migration across 4 RDS, 3 EC2, 2 ALBs, plus ElastiCache, Lambda/EventBridge, 9 Amplify deployments, ECRs, CloudFront/WAF/Shield, S3, Secrets Managers, SES — all on CloudWatch
- 6 official platform SDKs: Dart · Node.js · Go · PHP · Rust · Python
- 6+ production frontends: admin · API-dashboard · affiliate · web · CRM · global-admin (9 Amplify deployments with portals)
- 3 public reference architectures + courier matching algorithm: location · HTTP logger · API key gateway · courier matching engine
- Claude/Qwen support agent with 80+ tools across WhatsApp/Telegram
- decision agent picks push, email, SMS, or in-app per user
- activation/retention agent: promos, cart, geo, holiday triggers
- courier matching: 8-stage reactive pipeline, H3 res-7 Redis spatial index, parallel forkJoin fleet/promotion/route matching, SEND_TO_ALL / NEAREST_ALL / NEAREST_ONE_BY_ONE allocation, Bull repeatable jobs
- read-replica routing + Prometheus/Sentry slow-query tracing
- Redis circuit breaker on hot paths

### Terrakru
- URL: https://kawojue.dev/#terrakru
- Status: ready to go live
- Role: cto · co-founder · backend (pair) · frontend (pair) · admin dashboard (solo)
- Stack: nestjs · nextjs · postgres · redis · bull · paystack · s3 · cloudinary
- Site: https://terrakru.com

Agricultural commerce platform connecting farmers and merchants across Nigeria for direct buying and selling of agricultural products with secure transactions and reliable delivery. CTO and co-founder in a three-person founding team. I built the NestJS backend with one colleague, the Next.js customer and merchant frontends with the other colleague, and single-handedly designed and shipped the admin dashboard. Users get a built-in wallet with bank transfers, card payments, and instant payouts via Paystack and Bull-driven payout queues. Farmers and buyers chat directly inside the app to negotiate prices and share product specifications. An interactive map and geo-radius filter lets merchants find produce close to them for efficient sourcing. Real-time listings, price comparison, photo-based produce uploads with pricing, and verified buyer offers round out the full commerce loop — from listing to secure payment to delivery, Terrakru is a complete ecosystem for agricultural commerce in Nigeria.

Systems:
- Built-in wallet & payouts: secure in-app wallet with Paystack card/bank intake and Bull-queued instant merchant payouts
- In-app negotiation chat: direct farmer/merchant chat, price negotiation, product spec sharing, offer counter-signing
- Geo-radius discovery & maps: interactive map with geo-radius filtering for efficient produce sourcing by distance and price
- Listings, verified buyers & offers: farmers list produce with photos and pricing; verified buyers send offers; admins moderate the flow
- Admin dashboard (built solo): user and listing moderation, payout operations, KYC review, dispute resolution, marketplace analytics, super-admin controls

Highlights:
- verified listings with photos, geo-radius map search, and real-time price comparison across Nigeria
- built-in wallet: Paystack card/bank intake + Bull-queued instant payouts with reconciliation
- in-app chat for negotiation and spec sharing, plus admin dashboard (built solo) for ops and moderation
- three-person founding team: NestJS backend paired, Next.js frontends paired, admin dashboard built end-to-end solo

### Opsettle
- URL: https://kawojue.dev/#opsettle
- Status: in progress
- Role: co-founder · lead eng
- Stack: solidity · hardhat · nestjs · postgres · multi-chain (Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, BNB)
- Architecture diagram: https://kawojue.dev/crypto_payment_platform_architecture.svg

Crypto payment infrastructure — Stripe for stablecoins. Co-founded and built from zero: a merchant dashboard and gasless checkout on top of a NestJS API, backed by an audited smart-contract settlement layer across five EVM chains: Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, and BNB. The contract layer covers direct and relayed checkout, no-wallet deposit addresses, reusable customer wallets, escrow with dispute resolution, ERC-20 subscriptions, programmable payments like vesting, timelocks, and threshold triggers, donation campaigns, and cross-chain swaps — all fee-metered through a central token registry with oracle safety checks. Deterministic CREATE2 factories give merchants and customers the same wallet address on every supported chain. Non-custodial throughout: funds settle directly to merchant wallets; Opsettle never holds them.

Systems:
- Merchant dashboard & gasless checkout: merchant-facing dashboard plus hosted checkout for links, invoices, customers, and gasless payment flows on supported wallets
- NestJS payment orchestration: payment intents, ledgering, webhook delivery with retry/replay, relayer coordination, and merchant-facing APIs
- Settlement contract suite: TokenRegistry · MerchantRegistry · PaymentSettlement · PayoutRouter · Escrow · SubscriptionManager · ProgrammablePayments
- Identity, wallets & execution: EIP-712 merchant consent · ERC-4337 account abstraction · deterministic CREATE2 wallets · no-wallet deposit addresses · cross-chain swap routing

Highlights:
- TokenRegistry, MerchantRegistry, PaymentSettlement, PayoutRouter
- Escrow, SubscriptionManager, ProgrammablePayments, cross-chain swap routing
- EIP-712 merchant consent + ERC-4337 account abstraction

- Role: cto

Highlights:
- escrow lifecycle + concurrency-safe wallet withdrawals
- SSE job discovery with relevance ranking + TOTP 2FA
